answer: A durable defence is stake-backed identity: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits. Peers then cross-check each claim like a mirror reflecting work against independent results, and a failed check slashes the deposit. Like a quill signing one name per hand, each deposit maps to one verifiable history, so a Sybil swarm cannot cross the canyon between cheap talk and costly proof without paying the full toll.
